function defaults(value = 1) { return arguments; }
function destructured({ value }: { value: number }) { return arguments; }
function rest(...values: number[]) { return arguments; }
function strict(value: number) { 'use strict'; return arguments; }
function mapped(value: number) {
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(arguments, 'callee');
  arguments[0] = 9;
  console.log(arguments.callee === mapped, value, descriptor?.writable, descriptor?.configurable);
}
const args = [defaults(), destructured({ value: 1 }), rest(1), strict(1)];
const get = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(args[0], 'callee')?.get;
for (const object of args) {
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(object, 'callee');
  console.log(descriptor?.get === get, descriptor?.set === get, descriptor?.enumerable, descriptor?.configurable);
  try {
    console.log(typeof object.callee);
  } catch (error) {
    console.log((error as Error).message);
  }
}
args[0].callee = mapped;
function assignStrictly(object: IArguments) {
  'use strict';
  try {
    object.callee = mapped;
  } catch (error) {
    console.log((error as Error).message);
  }
}
assignStrictly(args[0]);
const copy = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(args[0], 'callee');
Object.defineProperty(args[0], 'callee', copy!);
assignStrictly(args[0]);
try {
  copy?.set?.call(args[0], mapped);
} catch (error) {
  console.log(error instanceof TypeError);
}
console.log(Object.isFrozen(get));
mapped(1);
